content_of_post_to_comment:
At all. never will. I decluttered almost everything. That helped fix my routine, helped simplify parts of my day and made other things easier. Not i need to do that with general lifestyle stuff but nothing really is outright bad/maladaptive so I cant seem to take it seriously enough?

Yes I'm almost failing classes and i'm probably going to get suspended if i don't do a 180 ASAP or drop. Nope im barely getting one assignment done a day. And im trying.

I know i can work on adhd with working out as its helped before but nope. Not sticking to that(i've been doing rudimentary 5 min workouts feeling like it takes longer).

Quitting coffee helps, but since I'm not doing drugs/alcohol/ect or other major vices its "no big deal" if i stick to just a cup or two a day. (despite the fact that its not working for me at all).

And I didnt have coffee for a day or two before and it just felt awesome? And then I had more coffee cause consistency with my ruinous daily habits I suppose. But I felt awesome, woke up, was productive, actually got things done in a way that makes me wonder if i even have adhd.

Then back to slowly falling further behind on my coursework(and im only taking 12 credits so i should theoretically have less issues).

"oh its not that bad" so i just go ahead and let it get worse and worse and worse.

Yes I like how just sticking to tea feels, nope get coffee cause i like the taste also slightly bitter milk!

Welp. Like its the last hurdle between me fixing my life but since its an action vs an item its so much harder to change.
